descriptions.d24c_input_process_16byte_800f94e8: When +432 is set and 0x800f899c accepts the record, push it on the vector at +332. When the vector holds more than 100 records: create the list object (retained), get one array per field, copy every record, empty the vector, send the list through virtual +40 of the sink at 0x804abac0, and release it.
